plan.summary: This first 4-week block builds a simple off-camp strength and power base for boxing with one focused weekly session that fits minimal home equipment and a beginner training age. Week 1 establishes a lower-body strength baseline with a safe multi-rep assessment so later loading can be guided more clearly, and the main training starts in Week 2. Across Weeks 2-4, the session keeps power first, then main strength, then practical accessories and brief conditioning while staying recoverable alongside boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body power, basic strength, and trunk support with simple high-value work that does not interfere too much with boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength and power work with slightly heavier loading while keeping weekly fatigue controlled.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen power and speed, and express the gains with lower fatigue and faster intent.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up gradually, then build to one hard set of 3-5 reps with good form. Log the load and reps from that top set so future work can be adjusted from your baseline.
